name: Japan CPI (index)
description: The national all-items consumer price index as the International Monetary Fund publishes it (dataflow IMF.STA:CPI). The Fund labels its reference period 2020A. It matches the Statistics Bureau of Japan's 2020-base file (e-Stat) for the months compared in docs/v2/japan-cpi-check.md.

migration.note: v1's series (OECD, through FRED) ends in June 2021. The Fund carries the national all-items index to date, on the 2020 base where v1's was on 2015: over the 258 months both hold, v1's figure is 1.017 to 1.019 times the Fund's, and the twelve-month changes agree to within 0.14 of a point (compared in memory on 2026-11-11; nothing was kept).
